items.title: Le futur proche
items.titleEn: "Going to": plans and things about to happen
items.body:
**aller** in the present + the **infinitive** of the verb.

Use it for plans and for things that are going to happen soon.

In the negative, ne … pas goes around **aller**: je ne vais pas travailler.

Compare: **le samedi**, je vais au cinéma (every Saturday, a habit) and **samedi**, je vais aller au cinéma (this Saturday, a plan).

items.en: to go out
